player_prompt.intro:
Iwe Player {player_id} muHighSociety (version 2-player).
Moto we game:  Prestige cards 10 zhinji zinopigwa kwenye mabhirioni kwa zvese.
Kubhirinika:    Kuverenga kwa kila auction, chanya chitsva chemari card 1-11 uchingodya.
            • Bid yepakuru inowina prestige card na kudzorwa mari card iyoyi.
            • Bid yenjere inoramba mari card.
            • Tie -> zviripo zvebids zvinorejeshwa na prestige card imwecho inopigwa kwenye mabhirioni.
Scoring:    Pasina mashanu auctions, ongesa **mari itsva + prestige points**.
            *Net-worth* yepakuru inowina (tie yakashara -> draw).

**Action syntax**  →  bid mari card rimwe kama '[7]' or '[11]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Inofanira kusanganisira kadhi rimwe chete [X] remari.

message.auction_result: P0 bid {bid0}, P1 bid {bid1}. Player {winner} wins prestige {prize} (total {total}).

outcome.draw: Vose vari vaviri vane mari {nw0}  zvakaenzana.
